theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let D := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let K := pointToIterateQuotientIndex (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β)
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
    (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  letI : Fintype D := Fintype.ofFinite D
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ D.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have hs : (univ.filter fun x => f x ≠ g x) ⊆
        (D.toFinset.product (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).image
          (fun p => F p.1 p.2) := by
      intro x hx
      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨(Q x, K x), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
          ⟨x, rfl, (mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
      · exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
          x (Q x)).mp rfl
    exact (card_le_card hs).trans (by
      simpa only [card_product, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
        using (card_image_le (f := fun p => F p.1 p.2)
          (s := D.toFinset.product (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))))))
  have hfw : 2 * d ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) -
      2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hid : (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) *
      2 ^ steps = 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) - 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
      show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
      show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega]
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    calc
      2 * hammingDist f g ≤ 2 * (D.ncard * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb
      _ = (2 * d) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc, ←hg]
      _ ≤ (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) *
          2 ^ steps := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hfw
      _ = _ := hid
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr hn

    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let D := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  change D.ncard = d at hg
  let Q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let K := pointToIterateQuotientIndex (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β)
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)

  letI : Fintype D := Fintype.ofFinite D
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ D.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by

          (fun p => F p.1 p.2) := by

      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨(Q x, K x), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let D := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  change D.ncard = d at hg
  let Q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let K := pointToIterateQuotientIndex (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β)
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
    (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  letI : Fintype D := Fintype.ofFinite D
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ D.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have hs : (univ.filter fun x => f x ≠ g.val x) ⊆
        (D.toFinset ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).image
          (fun p => F p.1 p.2) := by
      intro x hx
      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨(Q x, K x), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
          ⟨x, rfl, (mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
      · exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
          x (Q x)).mp rfl
    exact (card_le_card hs).trans (by
      simpa only [card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
        using (Finset.card_image_le (f := fun p => F p.1 p.2)
          (s := D.toFinset ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))))))
  have hfw : 2 * d ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) -
      2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hid : (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) *
      2 ^ steps = 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) - 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
      show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
      show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega]
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    calc
      2 * hammingDist f g ≤ 2 * (D.ncard * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb
      _ = (2 * d) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc, ←hg]
      _ ≤ (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) *
          2 ^ steps := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hfw
      _ = _ := hid
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr hn

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let D := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  change D.ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let Q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let K := pointToIterateQuotientIndex (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β)
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
    (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  letI : Fintype D := Fintype.ofFinite D
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ D.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have hs : (univ.filter fun x => f x ≠ g.val x) ⊆
        (D.toFinset ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).image
          (fun p => F p.1 p.2) := by
      intro x hx
      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨(Q x, K x), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
          ⟨x, rfl, (mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
      · exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
          x (Q x)).mp rfl
    apply (card_le_card hs).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ (D.toFinset ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = _ := by rw [card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  have hfw : 2 * D.ncard ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) -
      2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) := by
    rw [hg]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  have ht := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hfw
  rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
    show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
    show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega] at ht
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ :=
    Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans
      (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using ht))
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr hn

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let D := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  change D.ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let Q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let K := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β
    (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i.castSucc steps h_i_add_steps
  let F := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  letI : Fintype D := Fintype.ofFinite D
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ D.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have hs : (univ.filter fun x => f x ≠ g.val x) ⊆
        (D.toFinset ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).image
          (fun p => F p.1 p.2) := by
      intro x hx
      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨(Q x, K x), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
          ⟨x, rfl, (mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
      · exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
          x (Q x)).mp rfl
    apply (card_le_card hs).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ (D.toFinset ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = _ := by rw [card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  have hfw : 2 * D.ncard ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) -
      2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) := by
    rw [hg]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  have ht := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hfw
  rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
    show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
    show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega] at ht
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc :=
    Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans
      (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using ht))
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr hn
